title: Prepare charges for multi-currency billing
description:
Add an ISO-4217 currency_code column to the billing-service charges table ahead of the multi-currency rollout. Existing rows default to 'USD'.

Scope:
- Add currency_code column to charges table (default 'USD')
- Backfill existing rows to 'USD'
- Purely additive; no data deletion

Migration file: migrations/020_add_currency_code.sql. Pre-validated in CI (migration-lint stage); apply via the standard flow.
scope: Additive schema change to billing-service: add charges.currency_code column (default USD) and backfill existing rows. No data deletion.
